usage: core-device [-h] [--host HOST] [--port PORT]
                   [--device-file DEVICE_FILE] [--device-id DEVICE_ID]
                   [--device-name DEVICE_NAME] [--join-name JOIN_NAME]
                   [--device-type DEVICE_TYPE] [--platform PLATFORM]
                   [--capabilities CAPABILITIES] [--token TOKEN] [--no-tls]
                   [--ca-file CA_FILE] [--insecure] [--remember] [--no-portal]
                   [--portal-port PORTAL_PORT]
                   [--location-precision {exact,approximate,city,hidden}]

External C.O.R.E. device client (Option A: remembered device, login each
launch).

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --host HOST           Windows C.O.R.E. host/IP.
  --port PORT           C.O.R.E. TCP port (e.g. 5000).
  --device-file DEVICE_FILE
  --device-id DEVICE_ID
  --device-name DEVICE_NAME
  --join-name JOIN_NAME
                        Stable human-readable join name (generated once if
                        omitted).
  --device-type DEVICE_TYPE
  --platform PLATFORM
  --capabilities CAPABILITIES
                        Comma-separated list.
  --token TOKEN         Login token (else prompted).
  --no-tls              Use plaintext (localhost tests only; never for LAN).
  --ca-file CA_FILE     Custom CA/server cert for TLS verify.
  --insecure            Skip TLS cert verification (self-signed LAN certs;
                        explicit only).
  --remember            Save remembered device file (no secrets) and exit.
  --no-portal           Do not start the localhost client portal.
  --portal-port PORTAL_PORT
                        Localhost client portal port (default: 8766).
  --location-precision {exact,approximate,city,hidden}
                        Coordinate precision shared with other devices
                        (default: approximate).
